source_refs.note: Book p. 251-252: 8.5.3 Electronic Circuits, Example 3 Diode/AC Circuit (shown as Example 10): sin V - 0.5V = 0 by Regula-Falsi on [1, 2], V = 1.90 volts.

blocks.text: Ab electronics ki baari hai. Kitab kehti hai: diodes aur transistors jaise electronic parts aksar voltage aur current ke darmiyan nonlinear rishte (relationships) banate hain. Circuits mein kuch points par voltage ya current nonlinear equations ko satisfy karte hain. Aap ke mobile charger aur ghar ke UPS ke andar bhi aise hi parts lage hote hain.

blocks.title: Numbering note (ours)
blocks.text: Kitab is example ko 'Example 3' chhaapti hai (is unit mein yeh doosra Example 3 hai); hum ise Example 10 dikhate hain (8.5.1 wala note dekhiye).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yahan Regula-Falsi kyun? Bisection ki tarah yeh bhi root ko sign change wale interval mein qaid rakhta hai, lekin darmiyani point ki bajaye dono kinaron ko jorne wali secant line use karta hai, jo aam taur par root ke bohat qareeb girti hai. Is liye yahan sirf teen iterations kaafi hain, jab ke bisection ko das ke qareeb chahiye hotin.

blocks.title: Example 10
blocks.problem:
Diode/AC Circuit. In a circuit, the voltage \(V\) across a component satisfies the equation \(\sin V - 0.5V = 0\). Find a non-zero real value of \(V\) correct to two decimal places using Regula-Falsi method.
Note: \(V\) represents the voltage in volts.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin V - 0.5V = 0\), jahan \(V\) volts mein voltage hai.
Maloom karna: \(V\) ki koi non-zero (zero ke ilawa) real value, do decimal places tak.
Tareeqa: Regula-Falsi. \((a, f(a))\) aur \((b, f(b))\) ko seedhi line (secant) se jorte hain, aur jahan yeh line x-axis ko kaat-ti hai usay naya andaza maante hain. Sine ki wajah se calculator radian mode mein hona chahiye.

Function banaiye
\[f(V) = \sin V - 0.5V\]
Kyun: Regula-Falsi \(f(V) = 0\) ka root dhoondta hai. Dhyan dein, \(V = 0\) to seedha root hai kyun ke \(\sin 0 = 0\); is liye sawal 'non-zero' value maang raha hai, warna jawab bekaar sa hota.

Interval chuniye
\[f(1) = \sin 1 - 0.5 \approx 0.3415 > 0\]
\[f(2) = \sin 2 - 1 \approx -0.0907 < 0\]
\(\Rightarrow [1, 2]\) mein sign badalta hai.
Kyun: radian mein \(\sin 1 = 0.8415\) aur \(\sin 2 = 0.9093\). Ek value positive aur ek negative, to darmiyan mein root zaroor hai.
Dhyan dein: degree mode mein sin 1 = 0.0175 aata hai aur saara hisaab ghalat ho jata hai.

Continuity
\(f(c) = \lim_{V \to c} (\sin V - 0.5V)\) har \(c \in [1, 2]\) ke liye.
\(\Rightarrow f\) sign change wale interval \([1, 2]\) par continuous hai, is liye Regula-Falsi method \([1, 2]\) ke saath lag sakta hai.
Kyun: sin V aur 0.5V dono continuous hain, aur do continuous functions ka farq bhi continuous hota hai.

Regula-Falsi formula
\[V_c = \dfrac{af(b) - bf(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\]
Kyun: yeh woh point hai jahan dono kinaron ko jorne wali secant line x-axis ko kaat-ti hai (8.3.3). Graph seedha na ho tab bhi yeh line root ka achha andaza deti hai.

Iteration 2: a = 1.7901, b = 2
\[V_c = \dfrac{1.7901(-0.0907) - 2(0.0810)}{-0.0907 - 0.0810}\]
\[= \dfrac{-0.3244}{-0.1717} = 1.8891\]
\[f(1.8891) = 0.9498 - 0.9446 = 0.0052\]
Kyun: phir positive, to naya interval \([1.8891, 2]\). Dekhiye \(b = 2\) apni jagah se hil hi nahin raha; Regula-Falsi mein aksar ek kinara qaim rehta hai.

Checking
\(|f(1.8951)| = 0.0003 < 0.01\), is liye hum ruk jate hain.
Kyun: 1.8951 par \(f\) taqreeban zero hai (yeh 8.3.1 ki tolerance 0.005 se bhi kam hai).

Tasdeeq:
Sign test: \(f(1.895) \approx 0.0004 > 0\) aur \(f(1.905) \approx -0.0078 < 0\), yani root \(]1.895, 1.905[\) mein hai aur 1.90 par round hota hai.
Asal root \(V = 1.8955\ldots\) hai.

blocks.text: Checking: \(|f(1.8951)| = 0.0003 < 0.01\). Aakhri jawab: \(V \approx 1.90\) volts (do decimal places tak).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(b = 2\) kabhi kyun nahin hilta? \([1, 2]\) par \(f(V) = \sin V - 0.5V\) ka graph neeche ki taraf jhuka hua hai (\(f''(V) = -\sin V < 0\)). Is liye har secant line curve ke neeche rehti hai aur x-axis ko root ke LEFT par kaat-ti hai. Har naye point par \(f > 0\) hota hai aur woh \(a\) ki jagah leta hai; right wala kinara qaim rehta hai.
Aakhri jawab mein aakhri zero bhi likhiye: 1.90 (na ke 1.9), kyun ke yeh batata hai ke value do decimal places tak durust hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Is equation ko graph ki nazar se bhi samajhiye. Ek taraf y = sin V ki lehar hai, doosri taraf y = 0.5V ki seedhi line jo origin se guzarti hai. Jahan yeh dono ek doosre ko kaat-ti hain, wahi hamare roots hain. Origin par dono milti hain (V = 0), aur phir V taqreeban 1.9 par dobara.
Is ke baad line itni ooper chali jati hai ke sine (jo kabhi 1 se bara nahin hota) usay dobara nahin chhoo sakta, kyun ke V = 2 ke baad 0.5V hamesha 1 ya us se zyada hai. Is liye positive taraf sirf ek hi non-zero root hai, aur hum ne wahi dhoonda.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Kya is equation ka koi negative root bhi hai? \(f(-V) = -\sin V + 0.5V = -f(V)\), yani \(f\) odd function hai. Agar \(V = 1.90\) root hai to \(V = -1.90\) bhi root hai! Kitab ne sirf ek non-zero value maangi thi, is liye positive wali di.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text: Isi tarah \(\cos x = x\) ka root Regula-Falsi se \([0, 1]\) mein dhoondiye: \(f(x) = \cos x - x\), \(f(0) = 1\), \(f(1) = -0.4597\). Pehli iteration: \(c = \frac{0(-0.4597) - 1(1)}{-0.4597 - 1} = 0.6851\), \(f(0.6851) = 0.0893 > 0\). Do teen iterations ke baad \(x \approx 0.74\) milta hai.

blocks.title: Exam tip
blocks.text: Formula mein daalne se pehle \(f(a)\) aur \(f(b)\) un ke signs ke saath likh lijiye. Zyada tar ghalat jawab \(af(b) - bf(a)\) mein kho jane wale minus sign se aate hain.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
Circuit model: \(\sin V - 0.5V = 0\); \(V = 0\) seedha (trivial) root hai, non-zero root \([1, 2]\) mein hai.
Regula-Falsi: \(V_c = \frac{af(b) - bf(a)}{f(b) - f(a)}\); woh hissa rakhiye jahan sign badalta ho.
Sin ke liye radian mode.
Teen iterations se \(V \approx 1.90\) volts.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
Degree mode mein kaam karna: sin 1 = 0.0175 ban jata hai aur sign change hota hi nahin.
Jawab \(V = 0\) de dena: sawal non-zero value maang raha hai.
Formula ulta likhna, jaise \(\frac{af(a) - bf(b)}{f(b) - f(a)}\): har kinare ko DOOSRE kinare wali f ki value se multiply kiya jata hai.
